verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official MCP server that works with MCP clients like Claude and Cursor. It lets an agent investigate destination delivery errors, monitor pipelines, and write and test transformations. Its documented APIs claim programmatic management of connections and transformations. However, no evidence shows creating sources and destinations or wiring streams specifically, via either the API or the MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of source/destination creation and stream wiring through the API or MCP, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: RudderStack MCP works with any MCP-compatible client like Claude, Codex, Cursor, Visual Studio Code (GitHub Copilot), etc.
